advanced.title: Advanced settings.js
advanced.description: Edit the live settings.js file detected by nrcc. A backup is created automatically before saving.
advanced.unlockDialogDescription: This change is written directly to the host settings.js file ({{backupPath}}). A backup is taken automatically before saving. A syntax error in settings.js can prevent Node-RED from starting, which would take the orchestrator offline.
advanced.unlockAcknowledgement: I understand that a bad save can break Node-RED startup.
advanced.lockedBadge: Locked. Select "Unlock to edit settings.js" to edit the file directly; a backup is taken before any write.
advanced.directEdit: Direct edit · bypasses the change circuit (no diff review)

preset.acknowledgement: I reviewed the diff. Applying rewrites the managed keys in settings.js; NRCC backs up settings.js first and restarts Node-RED.
preset.unavailable: Curated presets are not available on this NRCC server.
preset.title: Curated presets
preset.description: Vetted recipes for advanced Node-RED 5 settings. Each one rewrites only the keys it lists and leaves the rest of settings.js as it is.
preset.reviewDiff: Nothing is written until you apply. Secrets in the diff are redacted.
preset.inputsHint: This preset needs the files it points Node-RED at. Enter absolute paths inside the Node-RED container.
preset.unchanged: This preset would not change settings.js.

error.needsInput: Enter absolute file paths (starting with /) for every field.
error.sourceNotExports: settings.js has no module.exports object this preset can patch.
error.notRegistered: This preset is no longer available on the server.
error.tooLarge: settings.js is too large to preview (limit 2 MiB).
error.generic: The preview could not be generated. Try again.
error.applyFailed: The preset could not be applied. settings.js was not changed.

restartRequired: Changing the console level requires a Node-RED restart.
runtimeLevelUnknown: Runtime level status is unknown; it is not safe to claim the configured value is running.

httpNodeCors.title: CORS (http-in endpoints)
httpNodeCors.description: Cross-origin response headers for the http-in nodes. Without this block a browser on another origin cannot read responses from your http-in endpoints.
httpNodeCors.enableHelp: Turning this off removes the httpNodeCors key from settings.js. Requires a Node-RED restart.
httpNodeCors.originsHelp: One origin per line: scheme and host only, no path. Use * to allow every origin.
httpNodeCors.methodsHelp: Keep the default set unless an http-in endpoint needs another method.
httpNodeCors.credentialsHelp: Sends Access-Control-Allow-Credentials so the browser forwards cookies and Authorization headers.
httpNodeCors.allowedHeadersHelp: Comma separated. Leave blank to let Node-RED reflect the browser's Access-Control-Request-Headers.
httpNodeCors.wildcardWarning: * allows every origin: any site a visitor opens in their browser can read your http-in endpoints. List explicit origins instead.
httpNodeCors.wildcardCredentialsWarning: * cannot be combined with credentials; the server rejects this configuration. Replace * with explicit origins.
httpNodeCors.unsupportedHelp: This hand-written block uses a shape NRCC cannot edit (a function, a regular expression or an unknown key). It is shown read-only and left untouched in settings.js.

aiTimeoutHelp: 30 seconds by default. Choose a value from 1 to 300.
aiApiKeyHelp: Write-only. Leave blank to retain the configured key.
aiAllowPrivateHTTP: Allow HTTP for loopback/private Ollama endpoints

flows.description: Review a redacted request before sending it to the configured AI provider. Results never change flows automatically.
flows.timeoutError: The AI provider timed out. Try again or adjust its timeout in settings.
flows.loadError: Could not load current flows or AI capability.
flows.disabled: Flow assistance is unavailable until an AI provider is ready.

actions.audit: Audit for obsolete or insecure nodes

flows.noPayload: No provider payload is sent in offline mode.
flows.requestError: The AI request failed. No flow changes were made.
flows.previewChanged: The preview is no longer current. Review a fresh preview before sending.
flows.importDirections: To use this candidate, import its nodes JSON manually in the Node-RED editor. Nothing has been applied.

aiProviderDesc: Configure optional, review-first AI flow assistance.

rotateSecretDescription: Saving a new credential secret invalidates the encryption of every stored credential. Existing flows with encrypted credentials will need to be re-entered or restored from a backup taken before this rotation. Continue only if you understand the impact.
rotateSecretAcknowledgement: I understand that existing encrypted credentials must be re-entered after this rotation.
